prerequisites: Basic fundamentals of the rest of the degree, especially in fluids, electricity, or pneumatics.

learning_outcomes.text: Students should be able to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competences usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and the resolution of problems within their area of study.

Students should have the capacity to gather and interpret relevant data (usually within their area of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.
Students should be able to transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.
Oral and written communication in their own language.
Knowledge and capacity for the calculation and design of industrial structures and constructions.
Understand the role of each installation in enabling a building to fulfill its purpose under adequate conditions of safety, health, functionality, and sustainability.
Know the design and calculation bases of installations, taking into account current regulatory requirements.
Achieve a general, never exhaustive, knowledge of the legal texts and technical instructions in the field.

Acquire the necessary skill to, through a holistic application of knowledge, achieve the globally most appropriate solution, understanding that there is not usually a single solution within regulatory compliance.

syllabus_topics: TOPIC 1.- BASIC CONCEPTS OF INDUSTRIAL INSTALLATIONS
TOPIC 4.- DOMESTIC HOT WATER PRODUCTION INSTALLATIONS
TOPIC 6.- THERMAL INSTALLATIONS IN BUILDINGS. VENTILATION AND AIR CONDITIONING
TOPIC 9.- INTEGRATION OF INSTALLATIONS IN THE BUILDING
TOPIC 10.- CALCULATION OF METALLIC INSTALLATIONS. EXECUTION OF A PROJECT
assessment_rules: For the ordinary examination, students must achieve a minimum total grade of 5.00 points and at least 4.00 points in the final practical exam. For the extraordinary examination and single evaluation, a 100% practical exam is required, with a minimum grade of 5.00 points. In case of elevated health alert levels, evaluation tests may be conducted via a virtual platform.
